Hamme

Saturday 23 January 2027

New on the calendar: Hamme. On Saturday 23 January, the UCI Cyclo-cross World Cup stops at the brand-new course in Hamme. Around the Mira Bridge, the riders will face an unfamiliar challenge. Who will be the first to put their name on the honours list?
